verdict.rationale: Proa documents async renderers that await data, loader caching through WebContext, and Suspense boundaries that stream slow data out of order. Its interactive islands are server-rendered with signals and event handlers, and each hydrated island ships with seed state, which implies server-provided data is handed to the client component. missing for 10: an explicit documented example of passing fetched data from an async server component into an island as props, details on serialization limits of seed state, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
